paper.title_en: Analytic Gravitational Wave Spectrum in Next-to-Minimal Bouncing Cosmology
paper.abstract_en: Bouncing cosmology offers a singularity-free alternative to inflation. However, its minimal realization, known as minimal bouncing cosmology (MBC), comprises only four cosmic phases and produces a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) with a single power-law spectrum. Interpreting the pulsar timing array (PTA) signal within this framework faces tension with the $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ bound and has required trans-Planckian bounce energies, restricting its observational viability. In this work, we propose next-to-minimal bouncing cosmology (NMBC) by adding an earlier phase of cosmic evolution to MBC. Using our previously developed primordial gravitational-wave propagation-matrix method, with an improved matching prescription, we derive explicit analytic expressions for the resulting SGWB spectrum. The spectrum takes a broken power-law form: the low- and high-frequency tilts are determined by the equations of state of the additional and original contraction phases, respectively, while the spectral amplitudes depend jointly on these equations of state and the characteristic transition-time scales. This additional freedom allows a PTA-band signal to coexist with a scale-invariant or red-tilted high-frequency branch, providing a way to satisfy the $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ bound. For the scale-invariant high-frequency branch, a pointwise benchmark using the adopted $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ radiation budget gives $ρ_{s\downarrow}^{1/4}\lesssim2.65\,m_{\rm pl}$, where $m_{\rm pl}$ is the reduced Planck mass. This provides a conservative comparison estimate for the setup considered here, since integrating the spectrum over the adopted illustrative frequency interval gives a tighter bound. The resulting upper limit is therefore of order the reduced Planck scale. please refer to the PDF for the full abstract.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接在反弹宇宙学框架内解读脉冲到达时间阵列（PTA）随机引力波背景信号，提出次最小反弹宇宙学（NMBC）并用传播矩阵方法给出解析的断裂幂律谱；与PTA信号及ΔN_eff约束的张力直接相关，理论深度和与主题的相关性较高。摘要未给出方法细节的验证程度，引用数为空不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 次最小反弹宇宙学中的解析引力波谱
decision.abstract_zh: 反弹宇宙学为暴胀提供了一种无奇点的替代方案。然而，其最小实现——即所谓最小反弹宇宙学（MBC）——只包含四个宇宙学阶段，并产生具有单一幂律谱的随机引力波背景（SGWB）。在这一框架内解读脉冲到达时间阵列（PTA）信号会与 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 约束相冲突，并且需要超普朗克尺度的反弹能量，这限制了其观测可行性。在本工作中，我们通过在 MBC 中增加一个更早期的宇宙演化阶段，提出了次最小反弹宇宙学（NMBC）。利用我们此前发展的原初引力波传播矩阵方法，并采用改进的匹配方案，我们导出了所得 SGWB 谱的显式解析表达式。该谱呈断裂幂律形式：低频与高频斜率分别由附加收缩阶段和原有收缩阶段的状态方程决定，而谱振幅则同时依赖于这些状态方程以及特征转变时间尺度。这种额外的自由度使得 PTA 频段的信号能够与尺度不变或红倾的高频分支共存，从而提供了一种满足 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 约束的途径。对于尺度不变的高频分支，采用所取 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 辐射预算的逐点基准给出 $\rho_{s\downarrow}^{1/4}\lesssim2.65\,m_{\rm pl}$，其中 $m_{\rm pl}$ 为约化普朗克质量。这为所考虑的设定提供了一个保守的比较估计，因为对所取的示意性频率区间积分谱会给出更紧的界限。因此，所得上限的量级为约化普朗克尺度。完整摘要请参阅 PDF。
